name: Numatic
legalEntityNote: Numatic International Limited is the UK company behind the Numatic professional-cleaning portfolio and Henry home-care products. Overseas subsidiaries and independent distributors provide regional sales and support, but they are not interchangeable with the UK manufacturer or with the seller and warranty entity named in a local contract.
headline: Numatic company, UK manufacturing, professional cleaning and Henry floorcare
description: A source-backed profile of Numatic International Limited, its UK manufacturing base, professional and home floorcare portfolio, distributor network and buyer verification points.
metaDescription: Numatic profile: UK company identity, Henry and professional cleaning products, Chard manufacturing, distributors, support and buyer checks.
disclaimer: World Clean Biz is an independent industry publication and is not affiliated with Numatic. Company-level UK manufacturing statements do not replace model, serial, seller, import, origin or warranty verification.

ownership.summary: The reviewed official materials identify Numatic International Limited as the company behind the brand and provide no parent company. Numatic describes a UK head office and manufacturing plant supported by overseas distribution subsidiaries and dealers; those roles should remain separate in procurement.

productPortfolio.name: Professional vacuums and dust control
productPortfolio.positioning: CleanCare and ProCare cover commercial wet-and-dry, cordless and specialist filtration applications.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Filtration class, accessories, duty cycle, battery platform and local parts support should be matched to the worksite.

productPortfolio.name: Scrubber dryers and floor machines
productPortfolio.positioning: FloorCare includes compact, walk-behind and ride-on machines, including the NX1K battery range.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Buyers should compare productivity, floor type, battery warranty, charging, consumables, training and service response.

productPortfolio.name: Janitorial systems and home floorcare
productPortfolio.positioning: VersaCare trolleys and systems complement the Henry-led HomeCare vacuum range.
productPortfolio.buyerRelevance: Commercial and consumer lines may use different channels, terms and support arrangements, so the quoted SKU and responsible entity matter.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Numatic states that its professional equipment is designed, engineered and made in the UK.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Current company-level statement on the official About page
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Verify that the exact model and serial range are covered and obtain country-of-origin and conformity documents for the destination market.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Numatic's 2024 modern-slavery statement describes its Chard head office and sole manufacturing plant, with parts assembled into final products at the UK site.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Numatic International Limited structure and supply chain described for 2024
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Request the exact product's factory record, critical-component origin and supplier-continuity information rather than assuming every component is UK-made.

manufacturingSupplyChain.evidence: Numatic's history says it acquired the Chard location in 1990 and continued expanding production facilities there.
manufacturingSupplyChain.scope: Company history and site development, not a current SKU-level origin certificate
manufacturingSupplyChain.buyerCheck: Tie the purchased model to current production and shipping records, especially where regional variants or sourced components are involved.

marketsChannels.evidence: Numatic publishes a supplier locator and says its distributor network covers many countries.
marketsChannels.scope: Official international dealer and distributor route to market
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Confirm current authorization, contracting entity, import responsibility and warranty coverage for the exact country and product.

marketsChannels.evidence: Numatic's history records distribution subsidiaries in France, South Africa, Germany, the Netherlands, Switzerland, Portugal and Spain.
marketsChannels.scope: Named subsidiaries and dates disclosed in the official company history
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Identify whether the quotation is from a subsidiary or independent dealer and record who owns service and warranty obligations.

marketsChannels.evidence: Numatic links customers to product documentation, training and support services, including Nu-Assist and Clean 360.
marketsChannels.scope: Official service resources; availability varies by product and market
marketsChannels.buyerCheck: Obtain local response times, technician coverage, parts stock, training scope and escalation contacts in writing.

competitivePosition.summary: World Clean Biz assessment: Numatic spans professional vacuums, floor machines, janitorial systems and the widely recognized Henry home-care line, supported by a concentrated UK production base. Buyers benefit from portfolio breadth but should verify regional seller, service and warranty responsibility separately.
